category_title: Students in an inclusive urban classroom exhibiting high-frequency disruptive behaviors and low academic engagement
scenario_title: Transition to independent work during reader's workshop
minimal_context: The student is transitioning to independent work at their desk following a mini-reading lesson during reader's workshop.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The mini-reading lesson is finished. Please sit down at your desk and work on your assigned task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and walks away from the desk area, talking loudly to a peer) I'm not doing that right now!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to sit down and focus on your reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes past another student in the congested pathway between the desks) Move out of my way!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please keep your hands to yourself and go to your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a pencil across the room) This is stupid! I'm not doing this [profanity] work!

TUTOR: The mini-reading lesson is finished. Please sit down at your desk and work on your assigned task.

task.content: Working independently on an assigned task following a mini-reading lesson

context.environment: Fourth-grade inclusive classroom during the class's 'reader's workshop'
context.materials: Desks, assigned tasks, crossword puzzles, number crunchers, coloring diagrams, journaling materials
context.social_setting: Working independently near peers with no distinction between group and individual space

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher makes a request to sit down at his desk and work on the assigned task
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Did not follow the teacher's request, exhibiting complete disregard for teacher direction or instruction, speaking without permission, and getting out of seat

behavior_patterns.condition: During independent work time when distracted by peers
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Calling out answers and profanities, throwing objects, hitting, and pushing, making unwanted physical contact
